title: Närkefrakt Delivery Event Schema
description: Schema for delivery confirmation messages. Optional fields with no value should be OMITTED from the document rather than emitted as null. Fields listed under 'required' must always be present.

eventType.description: Event type is always DELIVERED_TO_CONSIGNEE for delivery messages

eventTimestamp.description: Timestamp when the delivery actually happened (ISO 8601 format). May differ from messageTimestamp due to connectivity issues

type.description: Type of reference, e.g., ConsignmentNumber, OrderNumber, CustomerReference

deliverySignature.description: Name of person who signed for delivery

attachments.description: Base64 encoded files can be attached (e.g., delivery photos)

type.description: Optional type or description of the attachment, e.g., 'Goods Damage', 'Delivery Photo'

Header.description: Message envelope. These fields describe the message itself rather than the freight it carries, and are identical across all Närkefrakt message types.

messageId.description: Optional unique identifier for this message. Any string that uniquely identifies it — for example a file name, a timestamp, or a counter. Lets the receiver detect duplicates when a message is retried or redelivered.

messageTimestamp.description: Timestamp when the message was created (ISO 8601 format). Required: it is what lets the receiver tell a delayed message from a current one, so a message that omits it cannot be assessed for staleness. May differ from eventTimestamp due to connectivity issues.

messageSource.description: Which system, customer or integration the message originates from — for example a TMS or ERP name, a customer identifier, or the name of the integration that produced it. Optional but preferred: when several senders feed the same endpoint, this is what makes a message traceable back to its origin.

streetName.description: Street name (can include street number if not separated)
